{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].idxmax()]

# Print results
total_revenue_by_channel, best_channel"}
